message: Search alternative tool-using trajectories, score continuations and reuse failure reflections to guide later expansion.
scope: Official HotPotQA --algorithm lats --prompt_sample cot; shared mutable environment; reflection-to-policy only; not a claim of full-paper implementation equivalence.
composition: Landscape 1.9:1. Dominant search mechanism in central-left 55% of width; compact tools at upper right; reflection as a subordinate lower ribbon; input at left and output right. Shared alignment and compact returns. Do not imitate the author figure or create twelve equal cards.
mechanism: Use one schematic branching tree with local operation callouts: chosen frontier, newly expanded siblings, LM values and a dashed rollout continuation. Backup follows ancestors. Separate reflection ribbon communicates question-local feedback. Tree is an explanatory state-transition diagram, not decoration or a measured trace.
typography: Readable regular sans serif, medium-bold operation labels, one smaller tier for necessary conditions. No heavy black headings. Inspect at 7-inch width; keep same-size operation labels consistent. No lettering rendered as artwork.

blocks.label: Question
blocks.representation: Compact native-text-compatible input; no decorative icon

blocks.label: Trajectory search
blocks.representation: Dominant tree with local operation callouts and one short dashed rollout branch. No enclosing stack of cards; internal relations must be visibly drawn

blocks.label: Tools
blocks.representation: Compact neutral environment showing Search / Lookup / Finish; observations and QA-wrapper reward return, never invent an LM reward model

blocks.label: Reflection
blocks.representation: Small lower three-part ribbon: failed trace → self-reflection → question-local context; condition and policy-only feedback remain explicit

blocks.label: Return state
blocks.representation: Compact output with success / budget fallback; fallback is not guaranteed success

relations.display: Question enters root of the search tree.
Highlight one root-to-leaf route in the tree, labeled Select (UCT).
At that frontier draw newly sampled sibling states, labeled Expand.
Short action-call arrow from expansion frontier to tool environment.
Observation return from tools adds the expanded child records to the tree; not model training.
LM value callout attaches to eligible nonterminal new children.
Start a value-guided continuation from the best-valued child; not UCT inside rollout.
If rollout does not succeed, update ancestor statistics.
A thin return follows the ancestor path, labeled Backup; values/visits only, no gradients.
Wrong terminal outcome enters failed traces in reflection ribbon.
New distinct failures, only while unique total is 1–3, trigger self-reflection.
Reflection text is kept in question-scoped context.
Reflection context returns ONLY to Expand; never LM value.
Successful terminal or budget fallback may return a tree state.
Successful rollout or budget fallback may return a separately retained endpoint; do not draw endpoints as retained ordinary tree children.

forbidden: shared WikiEnv cloned or restored per node
rollout descendants retained as ordinary tree children
